Class Ray

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Ray
public class Ray extends Object
Represents a ray in 3D space, defined by an origin point and a direction vector. Includes energy tracking for ray tracing optimizations. FULLY GC-FRIENDLY - ZERO ALLOCATION in hot paths. All methods mutate 'this'.
